title: Using static methods declared on interfaces
answer: Use an interface static method by calling it with the interface name, such as Contract.validate(...). It is useful for contract-specific validation, factories, conversions, or helper logic that does not depend on an instance. Implementing classes do not inherit it as an instance method, which avoids confusing utility behavior with polymorphic instance behavior.
